version.description: Kernel version for which the initramfs is being generated. Passed as the first argument to the script.

bootdir.description: Directory where the initramfs image is written. Defaults to /boot, but may be overridden by the second script argument (kernel image path).

INITRD.description: If set to 'No', the script exits early. Used to skip initramfs generation for custom kernels that don’t need one.

DEB_MAINT_PARAMS.description: Debian maintainer script parameters. Used to prevent re-generation outside of 'configure' phase.
